snippet.title: Kira-Kira Catgirl Rampage -- Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Kira-Kira Catgirl Rampage is a difficult exploration-based beat-'em-up wariolike where pretty much every background object is destructible!
Follow Taiki & Ivy as they dispose of the rats & make Catgirl Kingdom a cleaner place!


!!Play the demo here!! -- https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/kira-kira-catgirl-rampage.2651/
!!Or here!!                      -- https://fuzzyepic3.itch.io/kira-kira-catgirl-rampage-demo

Yes, this is what we've been working on. KKCR has been in development since January of 2024!

Follow for video updates - https://www.youtube.com/@SealBitesGameDev
Support us! - https://www.patreon.com/sealbites

SONGS USED IN TRAILER:
Zoomies [Zander GComet, Fristo] 
Results [Gale Sosa]
